summary: Georgia Forestry Commission tower in Seminole County, built 1952 and last staffed 1988; still operational for emergencies. Public access not described.

facts.design: 100-foot Aermotor tower with a 7 by 7 foot metal cab

notes_for_editor: One register page carries the tower facts. The statewide blog is context only. Two web searches (Seminole County tower; Donalsonville history) returned no tower-specific pages. Local history pages checked had no mention. Access, fire history and current owner are not in any source read, so they are left out of facts. The register's nominator is not in the story. Height 100 ft converted to 30.5 m. The record's 43 m elevation is the NHLR site elevation, not tower height.
